counting_rules.candidate: One distinct exact implementation head sealed after trial start, counted once even if its receipt satisfies several commitments. Documentation-only heads count. Rejected or revised heads do not count as delivered candidates.
counting_rules.binding_only_repeat_reviews: Additional signed verdicts on unchanged source head caused solely by incorrect or missing commitment/report binding, after the first substantive review. A pre-sign refusal is recorded separately, not counted as a repeated verdict.
counting_rules.unchanged_condition_refiles: Replacement assignments whose requested result, performer, governing decision and conditions are unchanged, with only basis or lifecycle bookkeeping changed. Count once per successor request, not per cited artifact. Requires full request-chain inspection.
counting_rules.coordinator_handoffs_after_approval: Additional requests to a third actor needed to enable delivery after a valid substantive approval. Ordinary requester ratification, merge execution and routine status messages are not extra handoffs. Requires the durable path and any available related conversation.
counting_rules.contained_but_open: Implementation commitments whose reviewed head is contained by delivered main but remain unsettled after delivery reconciliation; report the observation time.
counting_rules.uncertainty: Null means not measured. Elapsed wall time is not active work, cost, or model effort. No aggregate improvement claim from this first candidate.
counting_rules.carry_in: Candidates already underway at trial start still count when delivered afterwards. Lifecycle-wide refile counts may predate the trial; mark carry-in history and do not attribute it to the new practices.
